question:
You are near the money bubble with 16bb UTG1. What hand should you jam?

Answer Choices:
A. QJs
B. None of these 
C. 99
D. AJo
E. AKo

1.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: E. AKo

With 16bb UTG1 near the bubble, ICM pressure forces an extremely tight jamming range—roughly 22+/AQ+/AK at most, often tighter depending on payout structure and stack distribution. Of the given options only AKo comfortably falls inside that range; it has massive equity against calling ranges and blocks the very hands that would otherwise call (KK/AA/AK). 

QJs is a clear fold—too many dominated scenarios and poor blockers. AJo is marginal-to-folding—dominated by any premium that continues. 99 is close but usually a fold UTG1; it plays poorly post-bubble if called by overpairs or sets and risks a large fraction of the field. Thus only AKo is a mandatory jam.

2.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: E. AKo is the only hand from the list that is a clear jam. At 16bb UTG1 on the bubble, ICM pressure forces an extremely tight early-position range (roughly 88+/AJs+/AQo+/AK). AKo is well inside that range and has both high equity and blocker value, so it is an automatic jam. QJs is a fold (too loose, dominated often), 99 and AJo are marginal at best and usually folds from this seat under ICM (they play better as shoves from later positions or with fewer players behind). Thus only AKo qualifies.

(The answer is not B because AKo is a standard jam; it is not “none.”)
